command: python -I ncd/run_problem_scout.py --config ncd\configs\problem_scout_section21.json --output-dir ncd/results/problem_scout/section22/steps_500_v1 --datasets NSL-KDD UNSW-NB15 CIC-IDS-2017 --methods replay replay_lwf rcl_tab icarl derpp --seeds 1 2 3 4 42 --min-steps-per-task 500

policies.ce: Existing inverse-current-minibatch-frequency class-balanced CE for every CE term, including DER++.
policies.cost: training_seconds is synchronized wall time for optimization only, cumulative across completed checkpoints; selection/evaluation seconds separate. Failed/interrupted attempts remain in logs and are not counted in successful training totals.
policies.derpp: Official CE + alpha logit MSE + beta replay CE, two independently drawn buffer minibatches, pre-update stored logits; classwise reservoir allocation replaces official global reservoir to match 200/class budget.
policies.error_flow: Mutually exclusive incorrect predictions: Normal first, then a class introduced later than the true class, then other old/same-task classes.
policies.evaluation: Task-known seen-label set at checkpoint, no task identity at inference; future/unseen true classes excluded. All supported seen classes reported, no recall floor exclusions.
policies.herding_storage: Current-class rows are gathered one inference batch at a time; float32 embeddings are preallocated or temporarily memory-mapped. The historical herding_select mean, dot products, order, precision and selection steps are unchanged.
policies.joint: Fresh initialization at EVERY task checkpoint; all prepared training rows of all seen classes; same epochs/optimizer/CE.
policies.memory: At most buffer_per_class stored examples per seen class; old full training pools are never revisited by CL learners.
policies.resource_measurement: CUDA allocated/reserved peaks cover optimization only, not exemplar selection or evaluation; host RAM peak is not measured. Large exemplar embedding matrices use temporary disk-backed mmap, whose resident file pages remain OS-managed.
policies.rng: Deterministic task-local seed = seed*10000+task_index; checkpoint-boundary resume uses exactly the same task-local seed.
policies.selection_change_from_history: Unlike historical _select_buffer, old classes retain only previously stored examples; only new classes access their current full training pool.

effective_config.derpp_allocation_adaptation: Classwise reservoir at 200/class replaces official global reservoir; objective and two independent memory minibatches retained; shared class-balanced CE and Adam/MLP protocol
effective_config.derpp_coefficient_source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aimagelab/mammoth/e75a491c69fd729edeb01431afb753d9157d9a81/models/config/derpp.yaml (seq-cifar100, buffer500); transferred fixed coefficients, not NIDS-tuned
